summary: The diff addresses both REQ-18 and REQ-19. GalleryPage.tsx is updated to use useNavigate with explicit onClick handlers for reliable navigation to /view/$shareId. ViewerPage.tsx is updated to wait for actor initialization before fetching, shows loading progress, and displays error messages on failure. App.tsx correctly defines the /view/$shareId route. However, ViewerPage.tsx appears to use an ExternalBlob/direct URL approach (pdf.file.getDirectURL()) rather than the chunked retrieval flow (getPdfChunks → getPdfChunk → reassemble) described in REQ-19.

missing_requirements.requirement: The chunked PDF retrieval flow (getPdfChunks → getPdfChunk → reassemble → iframe render) should complete successfully when navigated to from the gallery.
missing_requirements.reason: ViewerPage.tsx uses an XHR fetch against a direct URL (pdf.file.getDirectURL()) rather than the chunked getPdfChunks/getPdfChunk/reassemble flow explicitly specified in REQ-19. The AC mentions this specific flow and the diff does not show it being implemented.

hallucinated_features.description: Next PDF navigation button in ViewerPage that cycles through all gallery PDFs
hallucinated_features.reason: The diff implements a Next PDF navigation link in ViewerPage.tsx using useListPdfs to find the next PDF by index. This feature was not requested in REQ-18 or REQ-19.

hallucinated_features.description: Full card click handler making the entire PdfCard div clickable in GalleryPage
hallucinated_features.reason: The entire PdfCard div has an onClick, role=button, tabIndex, and onKeyDown handler making the whole card clickable. REQ-18 only asks for the Open button to navigate correctly.
